# CSC DOST (cscdost.online)

> Independent Digital Assistance & Information Service Desk

## Overview
CSC DOST (cscdost.online) is an independent private digital service portal providing online application assistance, sarkari job/result updates, admit card notifications, and document printing guidance.

## Key Services
- **Sarkari Result Desk**: Latest government job results, answer keys, admit cards, and notifications.
- **Online Form Filing Assistance**: Guidance and support for PAN card, Voter ID, e-Shram, Passport filing, and state certificates.
- **Application Tracking**: Track token reference numbers and status updates.

## Official Disclaimer
CSC DOST (cscdost.online) is NOT an official government portal and is not affiliated with CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd. Official government services can be accessed directly at https://csc.gov.in and https://digitalseva.csc.gov.in.
